meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude（agent）在启用的群组里获得 Gmail 工具，可搜索、读取、发送、草拟邮件，管理标签和过滤器等；调用时由 OneCLI 自动注入真实令牌，容器和磁盘上不会出现可用形式的原始凭证。
howto.when: 当用户在已接入 Gmail 的群组对话中提出查看标签、搜索邮件、发送邮件等涉及 Gmail 的操作时触发。

say.text: 列出我的 Gmail 标签
say.note: Claude 会调用 Gmail 工具返回标签列表。

say.text: 搜索我上个月收件箱里的发票
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索邮件工具查找匹配邮件。

say.text: 用我的 Gmail 给张三发一封邮件
say.note: Claude 会调用发送邮件工具起草并发送。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude (the agent) gets Gmail tools in enabled groups: search, read, send, draft emails, manage labels and filters, etc. OneCLI injects real tokens at request time, so no raw credentials appear in usable form in the container or on disk.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for Gmail-related actions in a group with Gmail enabled, e.g., listing labels, searching emails, sending emails.

say_en.note: Claude calls the Gmail tool to fetch labels.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month
say_en.note: Claude uses the email search tool.

say_en.text: Send an email to John using my Gmail
say_en.note: Claude drafts and sends via the email tool.
